description: Header file defining the du_cell_manager class and related structures for managing DU cells in a radio system.

classes.name: du_cell_manager
classes.description: Class managing DU cell instances, configurations, and states.

methods.name: no_of_cells
methods.description: Returns the number of managed DU cells.

methods.name: has_cell
methods.description: Checks if a cell with given index exists.

methods.name: is_cell_active
methods.description: Determines if a specific cell is active.

methods.name: get_cell_index
methods.description: Retrieves cell index from global ID or PCI.

methods.name: get_cell_cfg
methods.description: Gets the configuration of a specified cell.

methods.name: stop_accepting_ues
methods.description: Stops accepting new UEs in a cell.

methods.name: handle_cell_reconf_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for a cell.

methods.name: get_sys_info
methods.description: Retrieves system info configuration for a cell.
